summary: Connect service nodes to observed trace relationships while exposing incomplete coverage.
objective: Build a service graph from a trace fixture and let me inspect synchronous calls and asynchronous span links.
example_prompts: Build a service graph from a trace fixture and let me inspect synchronous calls and asynchronous span links.

entities.name: Services
entities.guidance: Use stable service labels with restrained extrusion; node size must have a stated meaning or stay uniform.

entities.name: Edges
entities.guidance: Distinguish parent-child calls from span links using labels and line style; direction follows the data contract.

entities.name: Trace inspector
entities.guidance: Show trace/span IDs in a technical inspection panel and time range; keep source records available.

state_contract.model: Explicitly labeled trace fixture or observed dataset, stable service identity, spans and causal links; layout is independent of timing.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Select an edge to inspect supporting spans.
Replay the trace and reset filters.

invariants: Every asserted observed edge has supporting input records.
Missing spans do not imply that no dependency exists.
Do not treat asynchronous links as an ordinary nested synchronous call.
motion_guidance: Use trace timestamps for playback only when supplied; label synthetic timing otherwise.
Layout relaxation never changes service identity or causal edges.
known_limits: Not a complete network map; trace sampling and instrumentation gaps remain visible.
No monitoring connector or live data is bundled.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: Span links can associate causally related spans, including asynchronous work tracked in another trace.
claims.scope: OpenTelemetry link semantics; no claim that links exhaust all causality.

object_craft.material: Uniform subdued service solids and distinct call/link line styles; glow must not imply unmeasured traffic volume.
